name: Cubes-TS-TW
title: 3D Cube Grid
blurb: 3D cube grid that rotates toward the cursor with ripple effects on click.
description: Displays a grid of 3D cubes with perspective transform that rotate toward cursor movement. Optional ripple animation on click. Auto-animates when idle. Uses Three.js for 3D rendering.
use_when: Interactive hero sections, portfolio backgrounds, or eye-catching data visualizations.
avoid_when: Mobile devices; high GPU cost. Browsers without WebGL support.
a11y: Purely decorative 3D background. Canvas has no aria attributes or keyboard interaction.
